channel.title: Azure Database for PostgreSQL on Sujith Quintelier
channel.description: Recent content in Azure Database for PostgreSQL on Sujith Quintelier

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Database for PostgreSQL enhanced Burstable tier (Basv2)
item.description:
Azure Database for PostgreSQL now has a public preview of the enhanced Burstable tier (Basv2). It keeps the burstable model but adds improved performance predictability and more efficient burst utilization for steadier, lower-cost workloads.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: PostgreSQL 19 on Azure Database for PostgreSQL
item.description:
Azure Database for PostgreSQL – Flexible Server now supports PostgreSQL 19 in public preview in the East Asia region. You can provision new PostgreSQL 19 servers via the Azure portal and Azure CLI.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Database Agent for Azure Database for PostgreSQL
item.description:
Public preview of Database Agent for Azure Database for PostgreSQL. The feature monitors database health proactively and helps detect, understand, and respond to performance and health issues faster.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Intel and AMD v6 with temp disk for Azure Database for PostgreSQL
item.description:
Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server is now generally available on Intel and AMD v6 compute tiers with local temporary disk. The new generation adds higher performance and larger scale options to the Flexible Server portfolio.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Intel and AMD v5 diskless tier for Azure Database for PostgreSQL
item.description:
Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server now generally available on Intel and AMD v5 diskless compute. The new General Purpose and Memory Optimized SKUs do not include local temporary storage.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Cobalt 200 compute for Azure Database for PostgreSQL
item.description:
Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server now generally available on Cobalt 200, a Microsoft-designed ARM64 compute option. It expands the Flexible Server compute portfolio with an additional architecture choice.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Database Hub real-time performance dashboards
item.description:
Microsoft Fabric Database Hub now provides built-in, real-time performance dashboards for Microsoft SQL, Azure Database for PostgreSQL flexible server, and Azure Cosmos DB. The dashboards are accessible from the Performance page and consolidate monitoring in one place.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: AI Assisted Oracle-to-PostgreSQL Application Code Migration
item.description:
A preview plugin adds AI-assisted conversion of application code from Oracle to PostgreSQL. It can be used through GitHub Copilot CLI or Visual Studio Code to help applications work with Azure Database for PostgreSQL.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Migrate Oracle databases to Azure Database for PostgreSQL using Azure Database Migration Service
item.description:
Azure Database Migration Service now supports offline migrations from Oracle to Azure Database for PostgreSQL. The preview lets you configure source and target connections, choose schemas, start the transfer, and monitor migration status.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Managed Redis database integration guidance
item.description:
Azure has launched generally available guidance for integrating Azure Managed Redis with Azure Database for PostgreSQL flexible server, Azure Cosmos DB, and Azure SQL. The update provides caching guidance, reference architectures, and related materials for application integration.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Migrate Azure Database for PostgreSQL to Azure HorizonDB with Azure Database Migration Service (DMS)
item.description:
Azure Database Migration Service (DMS) now supports migrating existing Azure Database for PostgreSQL workloads to Azure HorizonDB in public preview. The update extends DMS V2 architecture with HorizonDB as a migration target.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Database for PostgreSQL stable REST API version 2026-10-01
item.description:
Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server REST API version 2026-10-01 is now generally available. The release adds support for maintenance management, immutable backups, and multi-tenant encryption.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Major version upgrades (MVU) for Azure Database for PostgreSQL elastic clusters
item.description:
Azure Database for PostgreSQL elastic clusters now support major version upgrades in public preview. Existing clusters can be upgraded in place to a newer supported PostgreSQL version without creating a replacement cluster or migrating distributed data.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Long-term retention (LTR) v2 for Azure Database for PostgreSQL
item.description:
LTR v2 for Azure Database for PostgreSQL is in public preview. It replaces LTR v1’s logical pg_dump/pg_restore backups with physical snapshot-based backups integrated with Azure Backup Vaults.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Logical replication slot sync status metric for Azure PostgreSQL Flexible Server
item.description:
Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server now includes a new Azure Monitor metric, logical_replication_slot_sync_status, to track the synchronization status of logical replication slots. It is generally available and lets you monitor whether each logical replication slot is in sync.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: New and improved troubleshooting guides for Azure Database for PostgreSQL
item.description:
Updated troubleshooting guidance is now available for Azure Database for PostgreSQL flexible server. The documentation adds expanded diagnostics for high CPU, memory, IOPS, temporary file usage, and autovacuum issues to help identify root causes.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: PG18 support for Azure Database for PostgreSQL elastic clusters
item.description:
Azure Database for PostgreSQL elastic clusters now support PostgreSQL 18. The update is available generally and is intended for new or existing distributed, cloud-scale workloads.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: PostgreSQL skills and MCP plugin for Azure Database for PostgreSQL
item.description:
Microsoft previewed PostgreSQL skills and an MCP plugin for Azure Database for PostgreSQL. The plugin is intended to make supported AI coding assistants context-aware for PostgreSQL and able to provide guidance and perform actions on a connected database.

  • Source: Azure Updates
